items.quote: When Jethro, the priest of Midian, Moses' father in law, heard of all that God had done for Moses, and for Israel his people, and that the LORD had brought Israel out of Egypt
items.claim: Jethro heard about God's actions for Moses and Israel and the exodus from Egypt
items.object: all that God had done for Moses and Israel; the exodus

items.quote: Then Jethro, Moses' father in law, took Zipporah, Moses' wife, after he had sent her back, And her two sons
items.claim: Jethro took Zipporah and her two sons after Moses had sent them away
items.mechanism: after he had sent her back

items.quote: for he said, I have been an alien in a strange land
items.claim: Moses said he had been a sojourner in a foreign land

items.quote: for the God of my father, said he, was mine help, and delivered me from the sword of Pharaoh
items.claim: God was Moses' help and delivered him from Pharaoh's threat

items.quote: And Jethro, Moses' father in law, came with his sons and his wife unto Moses into the wilderness, where he encamped at the mount of God
items.claim: Jethro came with his family to Moses in the wilderness and encamped at the mount of God
items.object: unto Moses, at the mount of God
items.place: the wilderness, the mount of God

items.quote: And he said unto Moses, I thy father in law Jethro am come unto thee, and thy wife, and her two sons with her
items.claim: Jethro announced to Moses that he had come with Moses' wife and two sons
